_comment: Non-privileged alternative to the host-path bind. Open Horizon accepts ':rw' on a NAMED VOLUME without privileged:true, so this avoids the privilege requirement entirely. TRADE-OFF: the monitor's own service definition must mount the same named volume read-only (replacing its /var/log/workloads host bind), which you do not control -- coordinate the volume name and directory layout with the node operator before choosing this pattern. Note that MONITORING_LOG_PATHS is the path where the MONITOR sees the file (its mount of the shared named volume), not the /var/log/app path this workload writes to.
label: Sample monitored service using a shared named volume
description: A workload that shares logs with the monitor through a named volume instead of a host path.
